title: Touhou Kanjuden ~ Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom - Pure Furies ~ Whereabouts of the Heart
description:
Theme of the final boss of Touhou 15, Junko. This is in my top 3 best final boss themes in the series. I'd say it goes well in levels with an intense feeling or even bosses, with the amount of reverb given to it. I think it also fits the obvious, that is, space themed levels, just like in the game of origin.

UPDATE: Removed the weird click sound around 2:49.
